verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email API platform, and in-product AI insights such as summaries or suggestions are a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no first-party AI-generated insights or suggestions. Full-text search is keyword-ranked, not AI-generated. The LangChain vector-store indexing is a developer building block the user must assemble, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
